Cultural Branch

Compatibility: Bestial

The Frost-Hide minotaurs are well adapted to life in the harsh, snowy wastes. Their fur hide is thicker and comes in shades of whites and grays.

system.classDetails:
Frost-Hide Minotaur Traits

  • Attribute Increase: Your Constitution score increases by 1.
  • Cold Resistance: You have resistance to cold damage.
  • Frost Walker: @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.7AJZXIVS9CA03LF9]{Frost Walker}
  • Tundra Heart: @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.abilities.EYQFU3YGB3FQ3GXE]{Tundra Heart}
  • Alternate Heritage: Minotaur heritage can present in various ways. If your core race does not grant you Horns, you can choose to replace either the “Cold Resistance” or “Tundra Heart” trait offered by this branch race with the following ability:
    • Lesser Horns: You have horns, which function as a natural weapon that deals piercing damage equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier on a hit. You are proficient with your horns, but they do not grant any extra attacks, actions, or minor actions on their own.
